digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill Step 7 and plan-review-gate documentation
propositions: Step 7 must declare confirmed sibling bugs as acceptance-criteria checkboxes before Phase 2, making the class-level fix reviewable as a design family rather than independent one-off instances

Step 7 must record sibling paths via rebar set-file-impact and route the sibling set through rebar review-plan to trigger bug_blast_radius_escalates escalation out of the light advisory tier into the blocking-capable full rubric

Plan-review-gate documentation currently contradicts the shipped blast-radius escalation by stating a bug can never be BLOCKED; the escalation subsection must be added under R4 and the two contradicting never-blocks passages corrected
Step 7 commands must be conditioned on tracker type (rebar vs. generic) to maintain portability, with both the rebar-specific command names and a generic equivalent stated
A BLOCK verdict from the escalated review must halt Phase 2 until the plan is revised and re-reviewed; review-plan --force cannot override this agent-discipline gate
